generations.notes: Facelift 07/2024 not split: trunk volumes unchanged (FWD 450 L, 4Drive 420 L, e-HYBRID 345/1415 L per ADAC for both 1.4 and 1.5 e-HYBRID) and length differs by only about 1 mm (4450 pre-facelift vs. 4451 facelift). Height differs by variant: sources give about 1505–1537 mm, e.g. 1520 mm on the manufacturer's VZ e-HYBRID page and 1528 mm on another manufacturer page for the VZ. Sources give the wheelbase as 2679–2681 mm, and 2680 mm is used here. The 4Drive trunk is smaller (420 L) because of the changed rear-axle design and the top-view camera. The ADAC's own crate measurement is much lower (VZ 2.0 TSI: 320 L / 1185 L), but the values here are manufacturer VDA figures.

data.notes: The research was cut down to 12 searches, as you asked (80/20). Most values come from ADAC catalog entries (which reproduce the manufacturer's VDA figures) and official Cupra pages (AT/CH/DE/AU). Formentor facelift 2024 not split (trunk unchanged, length +1 mm). Born facelift 2026 split (length and height changed, trunk unchanged). Trunk volume differs by powertrain: Formentor FWD 450 L, 4Drive 420 L, e-HYBRID 345 L; Terramar ICE/MHEV 540 L, e-HYBRID 450 L (ADAC; UK sources 400 to 490 L depending on the sliding bench). Tavascan and Born have the same trunk across all variants. ADAC's own crate measurements (e.g. Formentor VZ 320 L, Tavascan 460 L) are lower than the manufacturer VDA values and were not used. Cupra Leon, Leon Sportstourer, Ateca and Raval are in the same brand range but were not researched because of the budget; see notFound.
